assumptions.cold: Reachable static and literal dynamic imports count once per URL. These are resource counts, not observed browser requests.
assumptions.compression: Node zlib gzip defaults per external resource. total compresses inline styles/scripts separately. page compresses HTML with inline content once plus external JS/CSS.
assumptions.warm: A second document navigation in the same build reuses every external URL reached by the first route, with no eviction or revalidation. HTML is fetched again. This is a cache model, not a browser measurement.
assumptions.modules: Rollup renderedLength identifies source contributions before final minification. It is not an additive allocation of final raw or gzip bytes. Mixed chunks may contain several roles.
assumptions.minimal: The isolated project contains only the measurement routes, uses the same public barrel imports and installed package links, and has no reference implementation. It is not a packed-package installation.
assumptions.excluded: Headers, latency, Brotli, HTTP cache policy, cross-build cache reuse, frame pacing, preparation timing and browser behavior.
